paper_title: Open problem: log(n) factor in "Local Glivenko-Cantelli"
statement: We conjecture that the log n factor in (2) is superfluous. This conjecture is motivated by the asymptotic lower bounds √ p lim inf n∆n ≥ c S(p), n→∞ (3) lim inf n∆n ≥ cT (p), (4) n→∞
context: S(p) := sup pj log(j + 1). j∈N We conjecture that the log n factor in (2) is superfluous. This conjecture is motivated by the asymptotic lower bounds √ p lim inf n∆n ≥ c S(p), n→∞ (3) lim inf n∆n ≥ cT (p), (4) n→∞ where c > 0 is a universal constant. This shows that beyond the conjecturally removable log n factor, (2) is tight up to constants. © 2023 D. Cohen & A. Kontorovich.
